faq.question: Who founded Skills Seekers?
faq.answer: Skills Seekers was founded by Pratham Kocher, whose passion for teaching inspired him to create a personalized, outcome-driven academic platform to help college engineering students excel in semester exams and master foundational concepts with high grades.

faq.question: What is the motto and vision of Skills Seekers?
faq.answer: Skills Seekers' guiding motto is 'Skills mein dum hai to .. manzil door nahi...'. The vision is to make engineering exam preparation structured, high-yield, and accessible through expert sprints, solved tutorial sheets, and verified PYQs.

faq.question: What are Skills Seekers' achievements and learner stats?
faq.answer: Skills Seekers has supported over 25,000+ happy learners, garnered 180,000+ views on its educational YouTube channel, and published 26+ semester crash courses and 50+ verified Bennett University question papers across all 5 semesters.

faq.question: What is Skills Seekers and BU Resource Hub?
faq.answer: Skills Seekers is an educational platform providing high-yield crash courses, solved tutorial sheets, verified PYQs, and 1-on-1 mentorship for university engineering students. BU Resource Hub is the dedicated academic resource portal tailored directly to Bennett University curriculum.

faq.question: How do I sign up and create an account?
faq.answer: You can sign up directly by clicking 'Sign Up' in the navigation bar and filling in your details, or by logging in through the official store at skillsseekers.com.

faq.question: What are the account and device limits?
faq.answer: Course access is strictly limited to the purchasing device only. The device cannot be changed later, and accounts will be automatically blocked if concurrent access is attempted from another device.

faq.question: Can I cancel an order or get a refund?
faq.answer: Per Skills Seekers platform policy, order cancellation or refunds are not allowed once a purchase is completed. Please review course details carefully before enrolling.

faq.question: How do I contact customer support?
faq.answer: You can reach customer support at skillsseekers16@gmail.com, via WhatsApp at +91 9588598168, or at vanshscholars2006@gmail.com for academic contributions.

faq.question: Is 1:1 personal coaching or mentorship available?
faq.answer: Yes! Dedicated 1:1 personal coaching is available with expert instructors like Pratham Kocher for personal doubt clearing, coding mastery (Java/Python/DSA), and exam sprint coaching. Contact Pratham Kocher via WhatsApp (+91 9588598168) or email to reserve your slot.

faq.question: How does the CGPA Calculator work?
faq.answer: The CGPA & SGPA Calculator (/tools) is configured for Bennett University's 10-point scale: O (10), A+ (9), A (8), B+ (7), B (6), C (5), P (4), and F (0). Simply add your subjects, enter credits and grade points, and it calculates your SGPA and projected CGPA instantly.
